answers.question: My instructor granted an `I` incomplete grade last term. What conditions had to be met, what happens if no grade is submitted by the deadline, and can this delay my graduation?

An `I` incomplete grade requires that at least 70% of assessed work is complete, the student was passing before an unexpected documented event, and the remaining work can be completed independently. Both the student and instructor must sign an incomplete plan. 

If no grade is submitted by the default deadline (the end of the next regular term), the `I` converts to an `F` unless an approved extension exists. 

This situation can delay graduation if the incomplete course affects degree requirements or GPA thresholds.
